status_note: Reproduces on Polars 2.1.0, the latest release, with `engine="streaming"`; the in-memory engine gives a result. The streaming reductions' `is_primitive_numeric` checks are unchanged on main (35a2cb73, 2026-11-04), read in the source; the one later change to `cov.rs`, [pola-rs/polars#30370](https://github.com/pola-rs/polars/pull/30370), does not touch them. No matching issue found.
summary: `pl.cov` and `pl.corr` of `Decimal` columns raise `InvalidOperationError` on the streaming engine and succeed on the in-memory engine. The streaming reductions (`new_cov_reduction`, `new_pearson_corr_reduction`) require a primitive numeric type, which a decimal is not, while the in-memory path casts decimals to `Float64`. The planner types the result as `Float64` for any numeric input, so the plan resolves and the query fails only at execution.
repro:
import polars as pl
from decimal import Decimal as D
lf = pl.LazyFrame(
    {"a": [D("1.10"), D("2.20"), D("3.35")], "b": [D("1.00"), D("2.00"), D("4.00")]},
    schema={"a": pl.Decimal(10, 2), "b": pl.Decimal(10, 2)},
)
lf.select(pl.cov("a", "b")).collect(engine="in-memory").item()  # 1.6916666666666667
lf.select(pl.corr("a", "b")).collect(engine="in-memory").item()  # 0.9843241382880894
lf.select(pl.cov("a", "b")).collect(engine="streaming")
# InvalidOperationError: `cov` operation not supported for dtype `decimal[10,2]`
lf.select(pl.corr("a", "b")).collect(engine="streaming")
# InvalidOperationError: `corr` operation not supported for dtype `decimal[10,2]`
handling: sverify doesn't work around it yet. The workaround is to cast both inputs to `Float64` before `cov` or `corr`, which is what the in-memory engine does and gives the same result.
